items.text: A Sales conversation a teammate passes you is listed at the top of your lists until you open it, with an email if you haven't within a few minutes. Assignment counts now match the filtered list, Seen shows at once, and every Sales rep can see Team activity.

Sales AI fields: write a field such as {ai_use_case} with a prompt and a research source (what you already know about the person, or their company's homepage). Each person gets one sentence from your own AI model, shown with the passage it rests on and its cost, editable before it sends. A sentence the research doesn't support is never invented. Reps have a daily limit you set.

Add an activity: record a call, a meeting or a chat on Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord or LinkedIn on a person, with when it happened and a comment. It shows on their timeline and in their Sales conversation, counts as contact (so a lead qualified on a call can be introduced to an account manager by a new email), and can stop a running sequence.
Changing a logged activity's channel now renames its title too, unless someone wrote their own title.

Sales AI fields: a sentence may name a few known products written like a domain (such as Node.js), and one refused for holding a link now says why. Answers that don't confirm what they found are never used as a sentence, a company site that couldn't be read is tried again sooner, and a failing page reader says so instead of reporting the site as unreadable.

Several email addresses per person in Sales: see and add a person's other addresses in the conversation, choose the main one, and merge the person another address belongs to after seeing their conversations, account and payments; undo it if wrong. Mail from any of their own addresses lands in the conversation, and a shared inbox such as support@ never joins two people.

A Sales conversation now has the person beside it: where they stand, their details, and their history and their company's, so you can qualify and write without leaving. Timelines read better everywhere: page views close together are one website visit that opens to its pages, payments and sign-ups stand out, and days are headed.

Add to pipeline: put a site or company on any pipeline in one click from an opportunity, a found site, a competitor's page or a CRM record. Opportunities and CRM pages now link to the pipeline cards a company has and show where else its site appears.

Rows in lists and tables are real links now: right-click "Open in new tab", a middle click or Ctrl/Cmd-click opens the item, task, page or person in a new tab, and a plain click still opens it in place.
